name: Isaiah
lede: The twenty-third book of the Bible, in full: the vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz — the vineyard of Jehovah, the seraphim crying holy, holy, holy, the burdens of the nations, Hezekiah and the host of Sennacherib, comfort ye my people, the servant of Jehovah, and new heavens and a new earth, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Vineyard of Jehovah
books.blurb: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: the ox knoweth his owner, but Israel doth not know; come now, and let us reason together — though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; the mountain of Jehovah's house, and swords beaten into plowshares; the day of Jehovah upon all that is lifted up; the daughters of Zion; and the song of the vineyard that brought forth wild grapes.

books.name: Holy, Holy, Holy
books.blurb: In the year that king Uzziah died: the Lord upon a throne, high and lifted up, and the seraphim crying holy, holy, holy; woe is me; the live coal; here am I, send me; then Ahaz at the conduit of the upper pool — ask thee a sign; behold, a virgin shall conceive, and shall call his name Immanuel; the River to the neck; the people that walked in darkness have seen a great light; unto us a child is born.
